title: Corey Won’t Sleep
style: Glitch industrial cyberpunk with distorted sub hits, broken machine percussion, and a relentless mid-tempo pulse; verse starts sparse with bit-crushed vocal chops and cold synth stabs, pre-chorus stacks whispered doubles and rising noise, chorus slams with chopped gang vocals and a warped bass drop. Short delay throws on the hook, static bursts between lines, and a sharp, glossy-but-grimy mix with heavy low-end pressure., industrial, sleep, tone, deep, reading, glitch, warm
